description: Draws from Pipeworx's original 162-card creative-constraints deck (perspective, limitation, medium, time, audience, inversion, scale, process, wildcard) — each card is one imperative sentence an agent or team can apply to any task (a launch, an essay, an onboarding flow, a dinner), with a one-sentence reason it helps. Interpretation is yours: the tool returns what was drawn and the procedure used, not advice. Optionally restrict to one or more categories. Pass `seed` to reproduce an exact draw later (the same seed, count, and categories always return the same cards); omit it for a fresh random draw — the seed used is always returned. Pass `session_id` from a previous response to continue a no-repeat session (draw-without-replacement across calls, hosted gateway only); when continuing a session, categories cannot be changed mid-session.

categories.description: Restrict the draw to one or more of: perspective, limitation, medium, time, audience, inversion, scale, process, wildcard. Omit (or pass an empty array) for the full 162-card deck.

count.description: How many cards to draw, 1-10. Default 3.

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible draw. The same seed, count and categories always return the same cards. Omit for a fresh random draw; the seed actually used is returned in `meta.seed`.

session_id.description: A session_id returned by a previous draw_constraint call, to continue drawing without repeating cards already drawn in that session. Hosted gateway only — answers session_supported:false elsewhere.
